scope: Tiny synthetic CPU sequence-PPO mechanics; not human preference data or a language-model alignment result.

rewardFit.objective: mean softplus(-chosen_minus_rejected_reward_margin) plus 0.01 times mean squared reward weight

rewardSemantics.model: fitted linear prompt-task by token-count reward model
rewardSemantics.sequenceRewardPlacement: The frozen fitted reward score for the observed response is placed only on its final valid action. For an EOS response it is placed on EOS; for max-token truncation it scores the observed partial response on the final generated token.
rewardSemantics.klShaping: Each valid action receives -klCoefficient * (frozen old-policy selected log probability - frozen reference selected log probability). This sampled rollout-shaping estimate is reported separately from the exact categorical KL at sampled visited contexts; the latter is not full sequence-distribution KL.
rewardSemantics.padding: Padding has zero reward, value target, advantage, policy loss and critic loss.
rewardSemantics.timeoutContinuation: For the critic bootstrap only, a max-token timeout has one declared deterministic synthetic continuation action: task 0 continues with responseA and task 1 continues with responseC, then ends. The post-timeout critic row is fitted to the frozen reward-model score of that continuation token for every response-token context. This tiny continuation contract makes the timeout bootstrap nonzero and testable; it is not sampled language generation.
